setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: A new project with playback stopped and Rate /1. Channel 1 plays range 1-4, MIDI 60, 62, 64 and 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, to its own MIDI output. Channel 2 is not set up yet. The norns shows channel 1's Device screen.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Give channel 2 its own MIDI output on the Device page, pattern 1 and the range steps 1-3, then open Masks and set its values: Note 79, Vel 40 and Len ½ on every step, with step 2 locked to Note 81, Vel 60 and Len 1¼. Select channel 1. Press Song (6,8), set the global length fader to 10 steps and copy slot 1 into slot 2 (hold (1,1) and tap (2,1)). Each slot is now ten steps long and both play the same four-against-three pair.
steps.title: Build channel 2 and a two-slot song

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Reset on song seq change and turn E3 right to On (the default). The row reads On.
steps.title: Check Reset on song seq change

steps.caption: Close the menu, tap slot 1 at (1,1) and press Play (1,8). Play slot 1 and the first four steps of slot 2, then press Stop. Ten steps in, the song moves to slot 2 and both channels start their loops again: channel 1 plays 60 and channel 2 plays 79 on step 11, as the MIDI strip "MIDI sent in this step" shows.
steps.title: Both loops restart at slot 2

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Reset on song seq change and turn E3 left to Off. The row reads Off.
steps.title: Switch Reset on song seq change Off

steps.caption: Close the menu, tap slot 1 and press Play again, then press Stop after the first four steps of slot 2. This time the loops carry on across the slot change: on step 11 channel 1 plays 64, the third note of its four-note loop, and channel 2 plays 81, the second note of its three-note loop.
steps.title: Neither loop restarts

title: Restart or carry on at a song slot change
